// gcf-one-step-undo-v2 · alignment/tree only; one consumed slot, no redo.
(()=>{
const host=document.getElementById('interactiveReview'),api=window.GCFAlignmentWorkflow;if(!host||!api?.captureUndoState||new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('view')==='synteny')return;
const seed=JSON.parse(document.getElementById('interactiveReviewData').textContent),key='gcf-one-step-undo-'+seed.review_id;
const bar=document.createElement('div');bar.id='reviewUndoBar';bar.style='position:sticky;top:6px;z-index:30;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;background:#fff;border:1px solid #ccd8e0;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 12px;margin:10px 0';
const button=document.createElement('button');button.type='button';button.id='undoLastReviewStep';button.textContent='Undo last step';const note=document.createElement('span');note.id='undoStepNote';note.style='font-size:13px;color:#52626b';bar.append(button,note);host.querySelector('h2').after(bar);
let restoring=false,lastInput=null,lastInputAt=0;
function encode(value){const texts=[],seen=new Map();const body=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value,(k,v)=>{if(typeof v!=='string'||v.length<128)return v;if(!seen.has(v)){seen.set(v,texts.length);texts.push(v)}return {$undoText:seen.get(v)}}));return JSON.stringify({version:2,texts,body})}
function decode(raw){const envelope=JSON.parse(raw);if(envelope.version!==2||!Array.isArray(envelope.texts))throw Error('Invalid previous-state record');return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(envelope.body),(k,v)=>{if(v&&typeof v==='object'&&Object.keys(v).length===1&&Number.isInteger(v.$undoText)){if(typeof envelope.texts[v.$undoText]!=='string')throw Error('Invalid previous-state text');return envelope.texts[v.$undoText]}return v})}
function previous(){try{const p=decode(localStorage.getItem(key)||'null');return p.state.review_id===seed.review_id&&p.state.scope==='alignment_tree'?p:null}catch(e){return null}}
function update(message){let p=previous();const c=api.current();if(p&&(p.state.group!==document.querySelector('[aria-label="Interactive gene group"]').value||JSON.stringify([...p.state.model_ids].sort())!==JSON.stringify([...c.ids].sort()))){localStorage.removeItem(key);p=null;message='Model choices changed. The alignment/tree undo snapshot was cleared.'}const busy=restoring||c.running;button.disabled=busy||!p;note.textContent=message||(busy?'Wait for the calculation to finish':p?'Alignment/tree · previous step: '+p.label:'One-step undo for alignment and tree');}
function checkpoint(label){if(restoring||api.current().running)return true;try{localStorage.setItem(key,encode({label,state:api.captureUndoState()}));update();return true}catch(e){update('Unable to save the previous step: browser storage is full');return false}}
function changed(event){if(restoring)return;const target=event.target;if(!(target instanceof Element)||target.closest('#reviewUndoBar'))return;
 const isInput=event.type==='input',label=target.getAttribute('aria-label')||'',type=target.type||'';
 if(!target.matches('[data-tree-member],[aria-label="Interactive alignment kind"],[aria-label="Outgroup sequences"],[aria-label="Outgroup basis"],[aria-label^="Tree "]'))return;
 if(isInput){if(!target.matches('input:not([type=checkbox]):not([type=file]),textarea'))return;if(target===lastInput&&Date.now()-lastInputAt<800){lastInputAt=Date.now();return}lastInput=target;lastInputAt=Date.now()}
 else if(event.type==='change'&&target.matches('input:not([type=checkbox]):not([type=file]),textarea'))return;
 if(!host.contains(target))return;
 if(!checkpoint(target.hasAttribute('data-tree-member')?'alignment rows':label.startsWith('Outgroup')?'outgroup':label.startsWith('Tree ')?'tree view':'alignment view')){event.stopImmediatePropagation();event.preventDefault()}
}
document.addEventListener('input',changed,true);document.addEventListener('change',changed,true);
document.addEventListener('click',event=>{if(restoring)return;const target=event.target instanceof Element?event.target.closest('button'):null;if(!target||target.id==='undoLastReviewStep')return;
 const ids=['realignSelected','rebuildCurrentAlignment','buildSelectedTree','clearOutgroup'];
 if(!ids.includes(target.id))return;
 if(!checkpoint(target.id==='buildSelectedTree'?'tree calculation':target.id==='realignSelected'||target.id==='rebuildCurrentAlignment'?'alignment rebuild':'outgroup')){event.preventDefault();event.stopImmediatePropagation()}
},true);
button.addEventListener('click',async()=>{const p=previous();if(!p||restoring||api.current().running)return;restoring=true;update();try{await api.restoreUndoState(p.state);localStorage.removeItem(key);update('Previous state restored. Undo consumed.')}catch(e){update('Undo failed: '+e.message)}finally{restoring=false;button.disabled=!previous()||api.current().running}});
host.addEventListener('gcf-review-state',()=>update());update();
})();
